head: Bargue Drawing Course teaches drawing the 19th-century way
dek: Bargue Drawing Course walks you through the 196 plates of Charles Bargue's classic drawing course in order, from simple profiles to full heads and figures. It was #78 among paid Education apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
details: It came out on 5 November and costs $9.99, by John Darley.
means: If you want to learn drawing step by step, it follows a course art students used for generations.
todo: Find Bargue Drawing Course in the App Store.
